title: ranunculus amoenifrons
intro: Ranunculus amoenifrons, commonly known as the Alpine Buttercup, is a plant species in the buttercup family. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Ranunculus amoenifrons include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce swelling and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and alkaloids, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
